defects.mechanism: neither useA11yRoving call passes manageTabIndex, so no zone seats a roving tab stop and every enabled button stays tabbable
yearCells.selected compares the cell year against the calendar's year prop instead of the picker's own pickerYear
the rendered month is write-only: no reader and no change event, so a parent's active write discards its own navigation
endpoints reach Calendar only through defaultValue, which useControllable reads once, so the view never re-anchors
the raw defaultValue prop is passed to useCalendarMonth beside the resolved value, so a bound field still seeds its month from it (CONVENTIONS SS7.2)
both steppers compute from the render closure rather than a functional updater, so two calls in one handler coalesce
horizontal arrows delegate to a wrapping roving model over a one-month item set, so the grid cannot cross a month boundary
the roving handler is built in DOM-query mode and handed to the virtualized branch, so navigation is confined to the mounted window
queryItems applies no visibility filter, so roving targets a treeitem inside a hidden held Activity and focus() no-ops after preventDefault
the guard counts hidden held rows, so a tab stop stranded on a display:none item blocks the recovery that exists to repair it
the empty-term arm returns before the latch resets, so re-applying a cleared term never re-seeds
the expansion set is a lazy useState initializer evaluated once, so a data or defaultExpandDepth change re-derives nothing
no event.target !== event.currentTarget guard, so keys bubbling from a focusable descendant become reorder gestures
hasChildren uses a null check, so a falsy React child reads as content and suppresses the empty placeholder

the index fallback keys a Map by the item, so equal items collapse onto one key (the last index wins)

the path branch tests truthiness rather than root-ness, so rootKey="" desynchronizes the renderer from the exported collectJsonTreePaths
the uncontrolled toggle map is keyed by path and never cleared, so a new document inherits the previous one's toggles
